graph_application_permission.name: Place.ReadWrite.All
graph_application_permission.note: Tenant-wide once consented; Exchange RBAC scopes do not narrow an Entra-consented grant.

not_authorized: Exchange.ManageAsApp as a side effect of Places writes
automatic workspace or desk mailbox creation
delegated Place.ReadWrite.All on the web application
places_write_prerequisites.terraform: No active declaration. Requires an ADR-016 policy amendment, exact plan classification and apply authorization; consent is a separate administrator action.

booking_write_candidate.residual_risk: Grants write access to all of the signed-in user's calendar events; no narrower delegated permission exists for creating events.
preconditions: ADR-016 policy amendment, exact plan and apply authorization
Project Owner and security approval of the residual risk

worker_exchange_prerequisites.role_assignment_model: Custom Exchange role group assigned to the registered service principal (New-ServicePrincipal, Add-RoleGroupMember) with only the cmdlets and parameters of the fixed allowlist; Entra roles such as Exchange Administrator cannot be customized or scoped and are not proposed.
worker_exchange_prerequisites.certificate: CSP-based RSA certificate (CNG certificates are not supported for Exchange app-only authentication); separate from the web certificate.
worker_exchange_prerequisites.recipient_write_scope_limit: A write scope cannot constrain a mailbox that does not exist yet, so organization-wide New-Mailbox capability is the residual risk of automatic creation.
